channel1.assumptions: selected allocator starts at core8800, both initial pointer pairs zero, first two rows preserved

command.policy: effective word also depends on state+8/+12, cap+16 and global policies; not always raw request

service.guards: count>7, target enabled byte+32, nonzero callback, allow mask bitcaller
service.arguments: pointers to domain0, effective value and mode0; actual calls/returns require stable frames and roots

reply.first2_words_only: selected path writes word0 and word1; does not initialize reply words2/3
reply.projection: 0x3877a/0x3877c clear low16; OR saved high16 from the same stable reply slot
reply.caveat: normal private stable slot/config; unrelated writers or aliases can invalidate this projection

conditions: copy mappings, SRAM and MMIO local/AP aliases, init order and pointer publication are conditional
queue config/indices, plugin callbacks, enabled flags, access masks, stack and packets preserved
BL/BLX/logging/policy calls return normally, preserve carried registers/private frames and selected roots/words
the local/API relay result is opaque; header projection is not proof of successful physical DVFS
no exclusion of dynamic aliases, global writers, other events, plugin routes or slot47 callers
